arChildNodes.szComment:
On the horizon, the clouds CRACKLE with lightning. LEVIATHAN MEPHISTO is tearing a hole open in our mind. A WAVE OF DARKNESS spreads outwards from the hole in the sky, HURTLING towards us. 

Player's jaw sets: gut-deep fear.

Lilith WHEELS on her heel, GRABS our wrist, holds our palm out.
Lilith plants a BLOOD PETAL in our palm.
The petal flowers into a BLADE. Lilith has us point the blade’s tip towards her.

Darkness surrounds us. Player FALLS into a sea of ink. 

Lightning FLASHES, revealing: MEPHISTO, leering down at us in the dark. 
 
We fall. And fall...
A BRIGHT METEOR follows after us, trailing light behind it.
The meteor reaches us – it's LILITH.
Lilith CATCHES us mid-air, ENVELOPS us in her wings.
Player wakes, held in Lilith’s grip. It’s the briefest moment of peace.
And then: a GALE hits us. We’re pulled to our limit, holding onto Lilith’s arm.

Player tries to PULL THEMSELVES UP, to bring the dagger to Lilith’s breast... 
 
But it’s not enough. We’re slipping.

Lilith’s wings are starting to disintegrate against the force of Mephisto’s storm. 
 
Player grits their teeth, finds their strength, and ROARS with ONE FINAL EFFORT.
